verdict.rationale: Productboard documents feedback records with customer attribution, links feedback to users and companies, and links notes to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization. That covers the core of seeing who said what alongside the feedback. However, most of this evidence is API-level, and there is little documentation of a PM-facing view of richer customer context (e.g., segment, revenue, CRM attributes) used to weight priorities. missing for 10: documented in-app customer context surfaced alongside feedback, customer-attribute-based prioritization (segments/revenue weighting), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters

citations.quote: Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.
Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities.
Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization.
Ensure developers are working on what really matters by sharing customer context and only sending fully-validated features into delivery.
